parameters.name: IsDefault
parameters.description:
Specifies whether to query the default caption templates. Valid values:

- true: queries the default caption templates.

- false: does not query the default caption templates.

> Default templates are built-in parameter sets. You can use them by specifying the copyFrom parameter in the AddLiveAISubtitle operation.

parameters.name: PageNumber
parameters.description: The page number. Valid values: 1 to 100.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The number of templates on each page. Valid values: 1 to 100.

parameters.name: SubtitleId
parameters.description: The ID of the caption template.

parameters.name: SubtitleName
parameters.description: The name of the caption template. The name can contain only digits, uppercase letters, lowercase letters, and hyphens (-). The name cannot start with a hyphen.
